description: Envoy Gateway monitoring Dashboard with exported metrics. Adapted from Envoy Gateway (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/envoyproxy/gateway); modified. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

panels.description: How long in seconds a subscribed watchable is handled.
panels.title: Duration Bucket: $Runner

panels.description: Average time the selected runner takes to process a resource update, in milliseconds. A rise means the controller is slower to react to Gateway API changes.
panels.title: Duration Status

panels.description: Current depth of watchable map.
panels.title: Depth
Statistics
panels.description: Updates the selected runner processed, by outcome. Failures should be zero: a rise means resources are being refused; read the controller's log.
Total number of panics recovered in the system.
panels.title: Recovered Panics

panels.description: How long a status update takes to finish for all Kind.
panels.title: Total Duration Bucket

panels.description: Average time to write a status back to Gateway API resources, by kind. A rise means the API server is slow or the controller is backed up.
panels.title: Avg Duration

panels.description: 99th-percentile time to write a status back, by kind. Long tails delay the Accepted and Programmed conditions users wait on.
panels.title: p99 Duration

panels.description: Median time to write a status back, by kind. The baseline the p99 is read against.
panels.title: p50 Duration

panels.description: Total number of status updates by object kind.
panels.title: Total

panels.description: Status updates by outcome. Failures should be zero; a rise means the controller cannot write conditions back to resources.
panels.title: Status

panels.description: xDS snapshots the controller built, in total and by outcome. Failures mean a configuration it could not translate: read the controller's log and the resource's conditions.
panels.title: Snapshot Creation Status
Finished Stream
panels.description: The highest bucket count of finished delta xDS streams. Context for how many proxy connections came and went; a steady climb means proxies reconnect often.
Maximum duration seconds for finished xDS delta stream connection.
panels.title: Max Duration

panels.description: Minimum duration seconds for finished xDS delta stream connection.
panels.title: Min Duration

panels.description: Total number of xds snapshot cache updates by node id.
panels.title: Update Total

panels.description: xDS snapshot updates pushed to proxies, by outcome. Failures mean a proxy did not get its configuration: check the proxy's connection to the controller.
panels.title: Update Status
Total Apply Duration Bucket
panels.description: Distribution of how long applying an infrastructure resource (proxy Deployment and Service) took, in cumulative buckets. Most of the mass should sit in the low buckets.

panels.title: Avg Apply Duration
panels.description: Average time to apply infrastructure resources, by kind. A rise means the Kubernetes API is slow or contended.

panels.title: p99 Apply Duration
panels.description: 99th-percentile time to apply infrastructure resources, by kind. Long tails delay a new Gateway becoming ready.

panels.title: p50 Apply Duration
panels.description: Median time to apply infrastructure resources, by kind. The baseline the p99 is read against.
Total number of applied resources sumed by kind.
panels.title: Total Applied Resources

panels.description: Total number of applied resources that succeed sumed by kind.
panels.title: Applied Resources Status

panels.description: Total number of applied resources sumed by infra name.
panels.title: Total Applied Infrastructures
Total Delete Duration Bucket
panels.description: Distribution of how long deleting an infrastructure resource took, in cumulative buckets.

panels.title: Avg Delete Duration
panels.description: Average time to delete infrastructure resources, by kind. A rise delays cleanup after a Gateway is removed.

panels.title: p99 Delete Duration
panels.description: 99th-percentile time to delete infrastructure resources, by kind.

panels.title: p50 Delete Duration
panels.description: Median time to delete infrastructure resources, by kind. The baseline the p99 is read against.
Total number of deleted resources sumed by kind.
panels.title: Total Deleted Resources

panels.description: Total number of deleted resources that succeed sumed by kind.
panels.title: Deleted Resources Status

panels.description: Total number of deleted resources sumed by infra name.
panels.title: Total Deleted Infrastructures
